title: Yummy Clay Pot Filipino Beef Bistek
description: A classic Filipino dish featuring tender beef, a sweet and savory sauce, and a hint of smokiness from the robata grill. Serve with steamed rice and a side of steamed vegetables for a complete meal.

ingredients.name: 1.5 pounds beef (such as flank steak or skirt steak)
ingredients.notes: Slice the beef into thin strips before cooking.

ingredients.name: 2 cloves garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic before adding it to the sauce.

ingredients.name: 1 avocado
ingredients.notes: Slice the avocado into wedges and serve on the side.

ingredients.name: 1 small onion
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the onion and add it to the pot with the beef.

instructions: Heat the clay pot or robata grill to medium-high heat.
Add the oil to the pot and swirl it around to coat the bottom.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until it is browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, black pepper, brown sugar, and salt to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the beef broth to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the robata grill or a preheated oven.
Cook the beef for 20-25 minutes, or until it is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Slice the avocado into wedges and serve it on the side with the beef and sauce.
Serve the beef with steamed rice and a side of steamed vegetables.
